about: SP-0113. This product's map to the portfolio icon vocabulary (ICON-SET, ICON-RENDER, ICON-EXTERNAL, consumer). Every glyph the application, its READMEs and its site draw is listed here once: a vocabulary meaning, a meaning asked for by proposal and pending, product chrome or illustration, or an external picture. Glyphs.xaml is generated from this file and assets/glyphs/ by tools/Sync-IconGlyphs.ps1; IconographyConformanceTests hold the three against each other.

meanings.name: Refresh
meanings.note: Import channels from the internet: loads the shared catalog again.

meanings.name: Add
meanings.note: Add stream, create collection, paste a channel (adds it), the Add stream dialog's default button.

meanings.name: Import
meanings.note: The import-from-address dialog's affirmative answer keeps the verb's own glyph in the answer hue (WINDOWS-UI 0.4 section 11 item 4).

meanings.name: Delete
meanings.note: Collections, downloaded streams, the imported catalog, the video components - each destroyed, not taken off a list.

meanings.name: Reset to defaults
meanings.note: A capture folder back to its default; the TV-schedule binding's Automatic, which hands the channel back to automatic matching.

meanings.name: Close
meanings.note: CloseAnswerGlyphButton is the one no-action exit of a window that has nothing pending: dismissing polarity, so the danger hue (WINDOWS-UI 0.4 section 11 item 4).

meanings.name: Cancel
meanings.note: CancelAnswerGlyphButton is a dialog's dismissing answer in the danger hue over a tinted face; CancelUntintedAnswerGlyphButton keeps the hue and drops the tint beside an irreversible act; CancelGlyphButton is a mono command that is not a dialog answer.

meanings.name: Volume
meanings.note: Shown while muted, captioned Unmute: the live control shows the action it performs (ICON-RENDER 4).

meanings.name: Picture in picture
meanings.note: The compact radio panel: keeps playing in a small floating window. The catalog declares the qualified label 'Compact panel' for a floating panel without video (ICON-SET 0.22 item E.2, answering proposal item 4); the label's forms in other languages are this product's own.

meanings.name: Pin
meanings.own: the catalog draws the off state as a 2-unit stroke; this product's templates paint fills only, so its copy is Material's outlined push_pin, the same picture as a filled silhouette (ICON-SET rule 1)

meanings.name: Help
meanings.note: SP-0230, CONTEXT-HELP rule 2: the one button every help-bearing window carries; F1 asks the same. It means help and nothing else. SP-0231, BOOLEAN-OPTION section 2 rule 2: an option's own help is the same glyph, named for its option (OptionHelpName, 'Help: <option>'), and opens that option's explanation instead of the surface's help page.

meanings.name: Open in new window
meanings.note: Opens a capture folder in File Explorer.

meanings.name: Minimize
meanings.note: The compact panel's window button, labelled 'Свернуть окно' / 'Згорнути вікно' - never the bare 'Свернуть' of nav.collapse (ICON-SET 0.22 item E.1).

meanings.name: Choose folder
meanings.note: The label's '..' that says a dialog follows is the label's, not the name's (the record's note).

meanings.name: Apply
meanings.note: A dialog's affirmative answer in the success hue (ConfirmAnswerGlyphButton); the same check in the mono look where the acting button keeps the accent fill or the command is not a dialog answer (ConfirmGlyphButton).

meanings.name: Reconnect
meanings.note: Retry in the playback-failure dialog: restore the connection that was lost.

meanings.name: Clear all
meanings.note: Clear the listening history.

meanings.name: Email
meanings.note: Send logs to the author: opens the mail composer.

meanings.name: Remove
meanings.note: Remove the exchange account from this device; the account itself stays.

meanings.name: Nothing
meanings.note: No schedule for this channel: nothing is assigned.

meanings.name: Stream
meanings.note: The live broadcasts of the account's devices, received by this app.

meanings.name: Exchange server
meanings.own: EXCHANGE-MARK 0.3 section 6: until ICON-SET folds the accepted proposal, a product shows the exchange mark's one-tone glyph in this row; own/ is svg/exchange-mark-mono.svg of that contract, path data unchanged and pinned in assets/exchange-mark/PROVENANCE.txt, where the catalog's copy still draws the two server bays

meanings.name: Live Broadcast
meanings.note: Outgoing capture and its live indicator; incoming broadcasts keep content.stream. own/ expands the catalog SVG's round strokes to filled contours because the WPF geometry template paints fills; the dot, arcs and dimensions are preserved.

private.reason: scroll bar line button - a part of a standard control, which the vocabulary puts out of its scope (ICON-SET 0.22 item E.3, answering proposal question 9); this product's dark-theme template draws it, declared chrome here, never a meaning
the check mark inside a check box - the control's own state chrome, stroked like the platform's
the check mark of a checked menu item - state chrome
the arrow of a menu item that opens a submenu - platform chrome, mirrors with the layout

the state triangle of a collapsible group header (COLLAPSIBLE-GROUP 1.1 section 3 rule 2): drawn pointing to the reading end, turned down by the template when the group is open and mirrored by the flow direction - it reports the current state, so it is not the nav.expand / nav.collapse action chevron
48 px empty-state picture above the empty-catalog text (ICON-SET rule 7, amendment item G)

external.surface: channel favicon (list, grid, pinned strip, compact panel, player)
external.fallback: monogram from the channel's own name on a colour derived from it (MonogramPalette)
the favicon tile, then the monogram
